key_insight: WEQA is a query-adaptive agent that combines an LLM with wearable-data analytics tools to answer health questions from continuous sensor data more accurately than fixed workflows.
clinical_relevance: The framework may improve how clinicians and users interpret wearable signals by making responses more grounded, useful, and clinically sound.
method: Uses an LLM controller to plan each query and route it to the right wearable analysis or pretrained model.
Unifies sensor analytics, predictive modeling, and external-knowledge auditing into one agentic workflow.
Built and tested on a benchmark of four open wearable datasets across three health domains.
evidence_signal: The authors report 24% higher accuracy than LLM and agentic baselines, plus a blinded evaluation with 12 medical experts and 8 users showing better usefulness and clinical soundness.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of tool integration and external knowledge, so real-world deployment could still face robustness and generalization challenges.
paper_title: WEQA: Wearable hEalth Question Answering with Query-Adaptive Agentic Reasoning
